title: Consent text states a concrete personal-data processing purpose
pass_summary: Consent text contains a concrete personal-data processing purpose.

evaluation.criterion: Determine whether the supplied consent text clearly states at least one concrete purpose for personal-data processing. Return PASS when a concrete purpose is stated, FAIL when consent is requested but no concrete purpose is stated, and MANUAL_CHECK when the excerpt is too fragmented or ambiguous.

remediation: Keep remediation in application logic; this shadow rule does not create user-facing findings.
limitations: Shadow-mode semantic pilot only. Does not create production Findings.

title: Privacy policy describes personal-data processing purposes
pass_summary: Privacy policy text describes personal-data processing purposes.

evaluation.criterion: Determine whether the supplied privacy policy text describes purposes for personal-data processing. Return PASS when purposes are described. Return FAIL when Evidence completeness is COMPLETE, the text is clearly a privacy policy, and processing purposes are absent. Return MANUAL_CHECK when Evidence completeness is PARTIAL, TRUNCATED, or UNKNOWN and the absence of purposes cannot be proven from the supplied Evidence.

remediation: Keep remediation in application logic; this shadow rule does not create user-facing findings.
limitations: Shadow-mode semantic pilot only. Does not create production Findings.

title: Privacy policy describes retention or deletion handling
pass_summary: Privacy policy text describes retention or deletion handling.

title: Privacy policy describes data-subject request procedure
pass_summary: Privacy policy text describes a data-subject request procedure.

evaluation.criterion: Determine whether the supplied privacy policy text describes how a person can submit requests about their personal data, such as access, correction, withdrawal, blocking, or deletion requests. Return PASS when a request procedure or contact path is described. Return FAIL when Evidence completeness is COMPLETE, the text is clearly a privacy policy, and no such request procedure is present. Return MANUAL_CHECK when Evidence completeness is PARTIAL, TRUNCATED, or UNKNOWN and the absence of a request procedure cannot be proven from the supplied Evidence.

remediation: Keep remediation in application logic; this shadow rule does not create user-facing findings.
limitations: Shadow-mode semantic pilot only. Does not create production Findings.
